name: Scholarship To 2 Years Pre-Service Student Teachers Undergoing D.El.Ed Programme At DIETs And CTTC Sohra
benefit: This scheme offers a scholarship of ₹5000/- per month for 2 years (10 months per year) to attract the state&#39;s best talent to take up teaching as a profession.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
   1. The applicant who wants to become a teacher may apply for the scheme.
   1. The applicant should be Class XII passed or its equivalent examination from recognized Boards/Councils with 50% marks with 5% relaxation for ST/SC/OBC/PWD.
   1. A candidate waiting for Class - XII results may also apply with the condition that they can produce their provisional/original documents at the time of counseling.
   1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 to 27 years and age relaxation will be up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/PWD as per the reservation policy of the government of Meghalaya. 

**Note:** There will be block-wise allocation of seats to facilitate the availability of trained teachers locally in the respective blocks.
> **Reservation Policy:**

  - As per the Meghalaya Government Reservation Policy for different communities of the state.
  - 5% of the seats will be reserved for persons with disabilities.

> **Allotment of seats:**

At least 30% of the seats are to be allotted to candidates having Science and Mathematics backgrounds at the Class – XII level.
